notes: Wealth adviser follow-up email to a physician prospect with a since-inception-only composite figure, a covered-call overlay pitched without its risks and an undisclosed testimonial, plus a fully disclosed third-party list designation as the decoy.

planted.span: Since its launch in January 2012, the Core Income Strategy composite has returned 5.4% a year, net of fees, through June 30, 2026.
planted.explanation: The only performance shown for the separately managed account composite is a since-inception annualized figure, with no 1-, 5- and 10-year periods anywhere in the email.

planted.span: For clients who want more from the stock sleeve, our Enhanced Yield option writes covered calls on the dividend stocks, collecting option premium every month and turning those holdings into a second monthly source of income.
planted.explanation: The covered-call overlay is described only by its income benefit, with no mention of capped upside, assignment and forced sales, tax consequences, or that option premium only partly cushions declines in the underlying stocks.

planted.span: As Dr. Warren Ellsby, a retired anesthesiologist in Maryville, put it: "Priya and her team turned twenty years of scattered accounts into one plan I actually understand, and I sleep better at night because of it."
planted.explanation: A named person's praise of the adviser appears with no disclosure of whether he is a current client, whether he was compensated, or any material conflict of interest.

decoys.span: In March 2026, Tamberlyn Voss was named to the Brantlow Wealth Survey's list of Top Advisers for Medical Professionals.
decoys.why_ok: The adjacent sentences give the publication date (March 9, 2026), the period the list was based on (twelve months ended December 31, 2025), the rater (Brantlow Media Group) and the $1,950 licensing fee paid, which are the disclosures 206(4)-1(c) requires.
